claim: You can use Amazon FSx to copy FSx for Windows File Server backups within the same account to another Region or within the same Region (cross-Region copies only within the same AWS partition), and you can use AWS Backup to copy backups across Regions and across accounts.
question: How can you copy FSx for Windows File Server backups across Regions and across accounts, and within what boundary are cross-Region copies allowed?

evidence.quote: You can use Amazon FSx to manually copy backups within the same AWS account to another AWS Region (cross-Region copies) or within the same AWS Region (in-Region copies).
You can also use AWS Backup to copy backups across AWS Regions and across AWS accounts.
You can make cross-Region copies only within the same AWS partition.
